name: Gateway of India
opening_hours: Open 24 hours · Ferries to Elephanta Caves operate 9:00 AM - 3:30 PM (except Mondays)
best_time: October to March (sunset over Mumbai Harbour)
rules: Security baggage screening at waterfront plaza
Authorized ferry ticket counters located along the jetty
visual_features: monumental yellow basalt archway standing on Mumbai Harbour waterfront facing the Arabian Sea with the Taj Mahal Palace hotel adjacent
description: The Gateway of India is an arch-monument, completed in 1924, on the waterfront of Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It was erected to commemorate the landing of King George V of the United Kingdom for his coronation as the Emperor of India in December 1911 at Strand Road near Wellington Fountain. He was the first British monarch to visit India.
